first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption. Promotional pricing could counter the competitor, but its documented 30-day retention harm conflicts with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify the primary supporting evidence and the key downside of the strongest competing response before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior test improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Although promotional pricing responds to competitive pressure, its verified 12% retention decline and failure at first renewal make it inconsistent with the primary objective.
